title: The readiness test seam copies the deadline-exceeded error text instead of sharing it with the real expiry branch, so its witness could pass after the product message drifts
outcome: run_engram_diagnostic_args_until (src/engram_host_adapter.rs) builds the "Engram {diagnostic} exceeded the {} second enablement deadline" ApiError in one helper used by both the real Ok(None) expiry arm and the cfg(test) expiry seam, so the seam's witness tests assert the product's own message.
acceptance: The deadline-exceeded ApiError is built in one function used by both the real expiry arm and the test seam branch; the seam no longer formats its own copy.
The readiness seam tests and the doctor and readiness deadline tests pass unchanged.
